DeployBot: Deployment started: service=runtime, env=prod-us-west, tag=release-2026.03.20-rc4, commit=ab12f7e, initiated_by=@Ava. Change window: 22:00-02:00 UTC.
Ava: launching canary 2/3. Watching latency.
Miguel: FYI rolling out KV cache change in this build; watch cache-miss rate.
DeployBot: Canary 1 healthy. Canary 2 failed healthcheck: 502 responses for 120s, healthcheck_cycle=3/3. Rolling back canary 2 automatically.
Priya: Seeing elevated 4xx on /v1/generate and timeouts in proxy logs (upstream=runtime). Investigating.
Jamie: Can we pin previous release to avoid traffic to canary? Suggest revert deploy + pin to stable.
Ava: Agree. Initiate rollback to previous stable. @DeployBot please rollback to release-2026.03.19-hotfix and pin.
DeployBot: Rollback initiated: target=release-2026.03.19-hotfix, env=prod-us-west, started_by=Ava, reason=canary_health_fail. ETA ~3m. DB migrations: none. Running rollout strategy=fast-failover.
DeployBot: Rollback completed: active_tag=release-2026.03.19-hotfix, commit=de9f3a2. Pins updated: runtime.latest -> release-2026.03.19-hotfix. Notifications sent to oncall.
Miguel: Confirming traffic returned to baseline, latency back to normal. Logs show the failure originated in new tokenization binary (segfault on certain long prompts).
Priya: Created ticket INC-2026-1123 and linked failing prompt set + logs. Adding evals for regression tests.
Ava: Good. We'll revert the binary change in feature branch and run an extended canary next window. Scheduling restricted canary in 1h with metric gates (error_rate < 0.5%, p95 latency < 250ms).
DeployBot: Summary posted to #eng-releases and #incidents. Rollback artifact: rollback-release-1859004321 created. Oncall notified: @Jamie @Miguel. Actions: pin stable, open ticket, schedule follow-up canary.
